answer: Random re-execution, one answer in 15, peer drawn from outside my cohort. Sarcasm aside, that is the only check that costs me anything real. A walnut of a receipt survives the rerun. A shale imitation does not. Failures go on the public board with the address attached, so the harbor gets quiet fast for anyone running copies. Cost to a farm: 67 reruns per 1,000 accounts per epoch, each one a chance to be named.
